'''Phantasmal Gardener''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. Four appear together in the encounter.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Phantasmal Gardener}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bite
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals 5 damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Lash
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals 7 damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Flail
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals 1 damage ×3.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Enlarge
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (2;{{Asc2|9|3}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
All four Gardeners cycle through the same four moves in a fixed order:
# {{Int2|Phantasmal Gardener|Bite}}
# {{Int2|Phantasmal Gardener|Lash}}
# {{Int2|Phantasmal Gardener|Flail}}
# {{Int2|Phantasmal Gardener|Enlarge}}
From the left, the first Gardener starts with Flail, the second with Bite, the third with Lash, and the fourth with Enlarge.

== Notes ==
* '''Phantasmal Gardeners''' gain {{KW|Block}} after the first attack played against them resolves. For example, playing {{C2|Twin Strike}} will deal 5 damage twice, ''then'' the '''Phantasmal Gardener''' will gain {{KW|Block}}.
** However, cards with '''Replay''' count as being played multiple times, so if an attack with '''Replay''' is played against a '''Phantasmal Gardener''' then it will gain {{KW|Block}} after the first play and before the second one.

== Useful Cards ==
* Any attack which hits all enemies, such as {{C2|Sow}} or {{C2|Dagger Spray}}, can deal a significant amount of damage.
* Damaging the '''Phantasmal Gardeners''' indirectly through non-Attack cards will not trigger {{BD2|Skittish}}, so cards like {{C2|Negative Pulse}}, {{C2|Flame Barrier}}, {{C2|Noxious Fumes}}, or {{C2|Haze}} can be useful against them.
* {{C2|Sunder}} deals almost enough damage to kill a '''Phantasmal Gardener''' in one hit, so it can easily finish one off and refund its cost if a basic attack like {{C2|Strike (Defect)}} was played on a previous turn.
** If upgraded, '''Sunder+''' deals enough damage to instantly kill a '''Phantasmal Gardener'''.
